ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (29) has a matching target block; 2 page marker(s) preserved in place; 7 numbered section(s); attributions: Cicero, Herbert Spencer, Henry George, Laveleye, Newman, If there is a person who has no right to land, then the right to land—mine, yours, every person's—is unlawful, Emerson, Carlyle.
Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (register, omissions, glosses, attribution form).

Land-tenure vocabulary is kept literal: «земля» (zemlya) is 'land' in the property sense and 'the earth' as the common mother; attributions follow the print (Laveleye, Newman). Henry George's «грабеж» (grabyozh, 'robbery') is repeated as in the source.
